conf.description: FireEye HX controller audit / CEF over syslog: shares the hx-alert CEF header parser shape with an audit-specific extension mapping (administrator identity, console client address, action outcome). event.outcome (ArcSight label-resolved slot) left as a documented gap -- cannot resolve without a live template sample.

conf.comment: fireeye-hx / hx-audit / syslog-cef. Same CEF header-regex + kvp-extension shape as hx-alert, with audit-specific keys (suser, src, msg). The outcome (success/failure) custom slot is label-resolved and unverifiable without a live template sample, so event.outcome is NOT populated -- documented gap, not a guess. suser vs duser for the actor identity is per the map's literal listed key (suser); confirm in-tool.

functions.description: record CEF parsing approach and the unresolved event.outcome gap
split the 8 pipe-delimited CEF header fields from the extension blob
explode the space-separated key=value CEF extension into top-level fields
derive _time from the original rt key before renaming (UTC-assumed parse, same as hx-alert)
batch rename every clean 1:1 field; msg (the only unbounded free text on this feed) goes to a custom field per the map, uncapped since no declared length was given -- see README gap
tag event.dataset and drop consumed/redundant fields; the outcome ArcSight slot is left in the event undisturbed since event.outcome could not be resolved
